project_type: Standalone React SPA — React 18 + Vite 5 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 3 + Supabase
build_system: Vite 5.4.21 with @vitejs/plugin-react 4.7.0. Build command produces dist/. No monorepo, no workspaces. All commands run from agency-ams/ root.
test_framework: None configured in Phase 1. Verification is done via `npm run build` (TypeScript compile + Vite bundle).
verification_instructions: 1. cd c:\Users\BK\Documents\Connect-saas\agency-ams\  2. npm install  3. npm run build  — must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors and no missing-module errors. 4. npm run dev — app must serve on http://localhost:5173 with login page visible.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is the build output (not committed). node_modules/ is not committed.
environment_constraints: Node 24.11.0, npm 11.6.1, Windows PowerShell. The .env file is NEVER committed; only .env.example is. VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are the only required env vars. Service-role key is NEVER in client code.
contribution_requirements: Do not modify any files outside c:\Users\BK\Documents\Connect-saas\agency-ams\. No Next.js. No dummy/mock data presented as real. RLS must be enabled on all Supabase tables. Only admin-authenticated users can access data.
key_patterns: All components are functional React components with TypeScript prop interfaces defined inline or co-located. Tailwind utility classes only — no custom CSS except src/index.css for Tailwind directives and font import. Branding tokens: Navy=#000F33, Red=#EC1C24, Gold=#D4AF37, Cream=#F8F4EF, Dark=#222222 — defined in tailwind.config.js theme.extend.colors as 'navy','red','gold','cream','dark'. Supabase client is a singleton in src/lib/supabase.ts. Auth state lives in AuthContext (React Context + useReducer or useState). ProtectedRoute wraps authenticated pages. react-router-dom v6 BrowserRouter with Routes/Route. Modal pattern: controlled boolean prop + onClose callback, rendered as portal-free fixed overlay.
directory_structure: agency-ams/ — project root with package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, index.html, .env.example, .gitignore | agency-ams/src/ — all application source | agency-ams/src/lib/ — supabase singleton | agency-ams/src/types/ — shared TypeScript interfaces | agency-ams/src/context/ — React contexts | agency-ams/src/components/ — reusable UI components | agency-ams/src/pages/ — page-level route components | agency-ams/src/db/migrations/ — Supabase SQL migration files | agency-ams/.agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts (never committed to app source)
